user.title: Home Upkeep
user.description: Set up the Home Upkeep panel.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Home Upkeep is already configured. Only a single instance is allowed.

import_from_api.name: Import from add-on API
import_from_api.description: One-time import over the add-on's REST API. Only works if the add-on's port is directly reachable — most installs only expose it via ingress, which this can't use. Prefer 'Import from JSON export' unless you know you've exposed the port.

base_url.name: Base URL
base_url.description: The add-on's base URL, e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8125.

import_from_json.name: Import from JSON export
import_from_json.description: One-time import of lists and tasks from a copy of the add-on's list_<id>.json files. This is the recommended path for migrating from the add-on.

path.name: Directory path
path.description: Path to a directory containing the add-on's list_<id>.json files.
